stem.text: A car of mass $500\,\text{kg}$ is at rest at point X on a slope, as shown.

The car’s brakes are released and the car rolls down the slope with its engine switched off. At point Y the car has moved through a vertical height of $30\,\text{m}$ and has a speed of $11\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.

stem.alt: Diagram of a car on a hatched slope: at the upper point labelled X the car is marked mass = 500 kg, speed = 0 m s-1; a dashed vertical height of 30 m is marked between the two levels; at the lower point labelled Y the car is marked speed = 11 m s-1.

stem.text: What is the energy dissipated by frictional forces when the car moves from X to Y?
